image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors on a grassy lawn wearing academic regalia. The person on the left wears a black gown with pink velvet panels and a mortarboard cap, holding a scroll. The person on the right wears a dark blue gown with three horizontal bars on the sleeves (indicating a doctoral degree) and a soft tam cap. Both figures exhibit significant anatomical anomalies, particularly in the lower limbs and feet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the upper portions resemble gowns, the garments fail to drape correctly to the ankles. The figure on the left has legs exposed below the hem in an unnatural way, and the figure on the right appears to have bare feet merging with the ground, breaking the 'full-length' silhouette.
The front panels of both gowns show approximate bilateral symmetry and vertical openings consistent with academic dress.

The gown on the left fails to obscure the leg contours properly; the transition from gown to leg is abrupt and physically inconsistent. The gown on the right obscures the torso but fails at the hemline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both figures display the characteristic wide, bell-shaped sleeves typical of doctoral or master's gowns.
Visible lapels and velvet facings are present on the front of both garments.
The figure on the right appears to be barefoot with no visible trousers or shoes, violating the context of formal attire worn under the gown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric rendering simulates a heavy, non-reflective material consistent with wool or polyester blends.
Lighting interaction with the fabric is diffuse and matte, lacking specular highlights.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Sleeves hang loosely and extend beyond the wrists as expected.

artifact_observations.location: Lower legs and feet of both subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic anatomical failure. The subject on the left has disjointed, floating white shapes for feet/boots that do not connect logically to the legs. The subject on the right has bare feet that appear fused into the grass, lacking distinct toes or ankle structure.
The hands merge indistinctly with the white scroll object; fingers are not clearly defined, appearing melted into the prop.
Facial features are smeared and lack sharp definition, typical of AI generation struggles with faces at this resolution.
Vertical lines of the building in the background show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective.

Boundary integrity between gown hems and ground
